text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: Latency SLO breach detected for route /v1/stream (eu-west-1). p95 420ms -> 870ms, p99 1.6s -> 3.8s over last 6m. Streaming stalls observed. Escalation level: page.
Maria (oncall): I have the page, looking now. Which pool/cluster?
Devon (eng-runtime): Root cause signal: node group gpu-eu-west-1a-ssd-02 showing continuous ECC correctable errors and thermal fan oscillation. Streaming tail stalls correlate with node 10.*.10.14. Dropping KV cache hits and increased compaction time.
Maria (oncall): Got it. Canary traffic still fine, but production routing is weighted 90/10 -> main pool. Can we divert traffic?
Alyssa (eng-infra): We can shift 30% to warm-pool-eu immediately and scale dedicated fallback. Doing a quick traffic reroute now.
Devon (eng-runtime): Before we reroute: adding a per-route fallback to quantized model variant (r_q8_2) reduces p99 but increases hallucination risk. Recommend routing to warm-pool + model fallback for streaming endpoints only.
Jorge (eng-sre): Also seeing increased connection resets in envoy logs from that node: 
```
[envoy] 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z connection reset peer=10.*.10.14 stream-id=0x1a3f
[gpu-driver] ECC_CORRECTED: 512 events in 10m, fan-speed spike to 95% then drop
```
Sam (CS): Heads-up: two enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, BrightHealth) reported degraded streaming; Acme has a demo in 30m. They want ETA.
Maria (oncall): Acknowledge. Sam, relay that we're actively mitigating by rerouting and will provide 15m ETA.
Alyssa (eng-infra): Executing traffic move: `redwood route update --route /v1/stream --weights main:60,warm-pool:40 --region eu-west-1`
deploy-bot: Started reroute: job id reroute-3955-01. Progress: 0% -> 20% -> 100%.
Devon (eng-runtime): After reroute p95 dropped to 220ms, p99 to 480ms for 2m, but we still see sporadic stalls when requests hit node 10.*.10.14 directly (old sessions). Need to drain and quarantine that GPU node.
Alyssa (eng-infra): Draining node: `kubectl drain gpu-node-10-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Alyssa (eng-infra): Drain started. Some long-lived streaming sessions are sticky; we can force-evict but that will cut streams. Thoughts?
Devon (eng-runtime): For live mitigation prefer graceful: enable session fallback to short-polling for affected sessions for 10m then evict. Add KV cache-by-pass for those sessions. Config change: `redwood config set --route /v1/stream --kv_cache.enabled=false --sticky_timeout=10m`
Maria (oncall): Apply that change. We prioritize availability over sticky sessions.
Jorge (eng-sre): Observability: adding temporary traces and increasing sampling on streaming tail to 50% to capture stack traces. Also bumping per-request timeout to avoid indefinite held connections.
Zara (hardware): On the hardware side: ECC corrections spiking + fan oscillation usually means thermal throttling or flaky PSU. If node is showing >1k correctable ECC in 15m we should RMA. I'll coordinate rack tech once node drained.
Devon (eng-runtime): Customer-visible mitigation summary for Sam: traffic shifted to warm-pool, fallback to quantized variant for streaming; KV cache bypass for sticky sessions; draining/quarantine of flaky GPU node; tracing enabled for tail; ETA 15-25m for visible improvement.
Sam (CS): I'll send an update to AcmeCorp & BrightHealth: brief technical note + ETA 25m. Thanks.
Maria (oncall): Update: 8m after reroute p95 210ms, p99 470ms, error-rate steady at 0.2%. Some 502s from long-lived clients during forced session fallback - investigating.
Devon (eng-runtime): Those 502s correlate with session eviction race. We can backfill by allowing short window of retry on client side; adding server-side graceful reconnect token in header. Patching now: `redwood patch route /v1/stream --add-header X-Reconnect-Token`
deploy-bot: Patch deployed to 80% of routers.
Jorge (eng-sre): Queue lengths look normal after reroute. Node gpu-eu-west-1a-ssd-02 shows memory ECC correctables tapering but still above baseline. We're keeping it quarantined.
Zara (hardware): Scheduling physical check and RMA for gpu-eu-west-1a-ssd-02. ETA tech 2h. We'll mark as DOA candidate if ECC persists after power-cycling.
Maria (oncall): Any customer impact remaining?
Sam (CS): AcmeCorp confirmed streaming resumed and quality acceptable for demo. BrightHealth still seeing intermittent stalls but much improved. They want postmortem.
Devon (eng-runtime): Action items: 1) Finish node quarantine + RMA (Alyssa/Zara). 2) Post-incident rollouts/analysis for KV cache sensitivity on streaming (Devon/Jorge). 3) Add alert for ECC-corrected-rate >300/min per GPU (Devon). 4) Update runbook for graceful draining of streaming nodes (Maria/Alyssa).
Maria (oncall): I'll start the incident timeline and allocate follow-up owners. Logging this thread to incidents board.
Jorge (eng-sre): Saving traces and logs to /incidents/3955551234/artifacts (trace ids: trace-0x7a9, trace-0x7b0).
Maria (oncall): Closing active page for now; monitoring for 45m. If p99 regresses >1s we reopen. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
